sources.locator: Title search: 联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准

statement.zh: **标准**：联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准（Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems）。FIPS 199 的骨架是`目标 × 影响等级`：§3 写「The security categories are based on the potential impact on an organization should certain events occur which jeopardize the information and information systems needed by the organization to accomplish its assigned mission, protect its assets, fulfill its legal responsibilities, maintain its day-to-day functions, and protect individuals.」并借 FISMA 给出三个安全目标——「The FISMA defines three security objectives for information and information systems」，分别是保密性、完整性与可用性，其中保密性的定义直接引自 44 U.S.C.
statement.en: **Standard**: Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems (联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准).The skeleton of FIPS 199 is objectives crossed with impact levels: §3 states "The security categories are based on the potential impact on an organization should certain events occur which jeopardize the information and information systems needed by the organization to accomplish its assigned mission, protect its assets, fulfill its legal responsibilities, maintain its day-to-day functions, and protect individuals.

statement.zh: 之所以需要统一分类，是为了让风险判断可比：正文强调「Security categories are to be used in conjunction with vulnerability and threat information in assessing the risk to an organization.」并在目标之外定义后果——「A loss of confidentiality is the unauthorized disclosure of information.」，把`泄露/篡改/失效`映射到可讨论的影响值上。
statement.en: A shared categorisation exists so risk judgements become comparable: the text stresses "Security categories are to be used in conjunction with vulnerability and threat information in assessing the risk to an organization." and defines the consequences outside the objectives themselves — "A loss of confidentiality is the unauthorized disclosure of information." — mapping disclosure, tampering and outage onto discussable impact values.

statement.zh: 适用与算法都写死：§2「These standards shall apply to: (i) all information within the federal government other than that information that has been determined pursuant to Executive Order 12958, as amended by Executive Order 13292, or any predecessor order, or by the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, to require protection against unauthorized disclosure and is marked to indicate its classified status」——排除条件是已依行政令定密并标注密级，且「Agency officials shall use the security categorizations described in FIPS Publication 199 whenever there is a federal requirement to provide such a categorization」。
statement.en: Applicability and the aggregation rule are explicit: §2 "These standards shall apply to: (i) all information within the federal government other than that information that has been determined pursuant to Executive Order 12958, as amended by Executive Order 13292, or any predecessor order, or by the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, to require protection against unauthorized disclosure and is marked to indicate its classified status" — the carve-out is classified information that is so marked — and "Agency officials shall use the security categorizations described in FIPS Publication 199 whenever there is a federal requirement to provide such a categorization".

statement.zh: 联邦信息与信息系统安全分类标准的broken见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: Two limits are in the sentence set: categorisation does not cover every system, because the same clause excludes "all federal information systems other than those information systems designated as national security systems as defined in 44 United States Code Section 3542(b)(2)"; and it binds only the federal government, others "may consider" it — "State, local, and tribal governments as well as private sector organizations comprising the critical infrastructure of the United States may consider the use of these standards as appropriate."。.

statement.zh: 标准名为「Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems」，文件日期栏写 February 2004，即 2004 年 2 月；生效方式写明「These standards are effective upon approval by the Secretary of Commerce.」，与后续 NIST 指南的分工也在 §1 交代——「Subsequent NIST standards and guidelines will address the second and third tasks cited.」。
statement.en: The standard is named "Standards for Security Categorization of Federal Information and Information Systems" and dated February 2004 in its own front matter; effectivity is stated as "These standards are effective upon approval by the Secretary of Commerce." and the division of labour with later guidance is set out in §1 — "Subsequent NIST standards and guidelines will address the second and third tasks cited."。.
